members.title: Members
members.remove_description: {{email}} will lose access to this organization. The vehicles they own will be handed over to you: transfer them first if they should go to someone else.
members.role_to_owner: {{name}} will become an owner of the organization, with the same full control as you: they will also be able to demote other owners and admins.
members.role_owner_demoted: {{name}} will no longer be an owner and will become {{role}}: they will lose control of the organization. The pending invitations they sent will be deleted.
members.role_self_demoted: You will no longer be an owner: you will become {{role}} and lose control of the organization. Getting the role back will need another owner. Your pending invitations will be deleted.
members.role_admin_to_member: {{name}} will no longer be an admin and will only see the vehicles they own or that are shared with them. The pending invitations they sent will be deleted; the vehicles they own stay theirs.
members.role_member_to_admin: {{name}} will become an admin: they will be able to view, edit, archive and delete every vehicle of the organization, manage members and invite more people.

transfer.section_description: Hand the vehicle over to another organization member: from then on its totals, charts and reminders are theirs.

transfer.keep_access_hint: If you clear it, you will no longer see this vehicle after the transfer (unless you are an owner or admin of the organization).
transfer.warning: Totals and charts follow the CURRENT owner, so the vehicle's whole history moves to the new owner and stops counting for you. The new owner will be notified, and at the next send also about reminders that are already due.
